healthcare_specific_indicators: Partial encryption allows systems to APPEAR functional while being rendered useless (database corruption)
Targets QuickBooks and pharmacy billing software in addition to PHI databases
Uses callback phishing (fake IT support calls) for initial access to small medical practices
Often encrypts on Friday evenings to maximize weekend downtime impact
recommended_defenses: Implement account lockout policies and strong password requirements for all admin accounts
Monitor for partial-encryption indicators (files with .royal extension but still partially readable)
Train staff on callback phishing and fake IT support calls
Require callback verification for any unsolicited IT support contact
Deploy weekend/holiday anomaly alerting for mass file modification events
